description: Calculates raw.size (character length of the original event) for raw-vs-indexed size analysis

script.source: if (ctx.event?.original != null) { if (ctx.raw == null) ctx.raw = [:]; ctx.raw.size = ctx.event.original.length(); }
if (ctx.containsKey('raw') && ctx.raw.size != null) return; if (ctx.message != null) { if (ctx.raw == null) ctx.raw = [:]; ctx.raw.size = ctx.message.length(); }

if (ctx.containsKey('raw') && ctx.raw.size != null && ctx.containsKey('message') && ctx.message != null) return; if (ctx.query != null) { if (ctx.raw == null) ctx.raw = [:]; ctx.raw.size = ctx.query.length(); }
